machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory
scope: Measured review of plan-4-speedup.md at the requested 256x256 production shape

cache_dit_gpu_relative_l1.design: Two Metal reductions return the absolute-difference and absolute-reference sums as two FP32 scalars instead of scanning the full first-block residual on the CPU.
cache_dit_gpu_relative_l1.interpretation: GPU-frequency variation moves the full-step totals. The clean repeats save 91-466 ms wall versus the immediate baseline, while cached-step wall readings fall from roughly 26-36 ms to 22-27 ms. The change is accepted primarily because it removes a resolution-squared CPU readback and is more valuable at 4096 target rows.

production_attention_dispatch_extent.design: Dispatch ceil(query_rows/2) groups for the two-query production kernel instead of launching a second half of groups that return immediately.
production_attention_dispatch_extent.reason: The 256 full-loop difference was within run-to-run noise, but avoiding known-empty groups is correct and becomes more relevant at larger query counts.

vae_arena_right_sizing.note: A first, smaller allocation was rejected after the 256 oracle exposed the block-4 norm1 buffer's 288-channel requirement.

flash8_cooperative_matrix_attention.design: One SIMD group owns eight queries; a first QK pass finds row maxima and a second QK pass computes normalized P*V using simdgroup 8x8 matrices.
flash8_cooperative_matrix_attention.reason: Numerics pass, but the extra QK pass, threadgroup staging, barriers, and lower occupancy make cached attention 3.12x slower at 256. The prototype was removed rather than adding runtime compile cost.

deferred.text_weight_ring: Potentially the largest 256 startup win, but it is a separate text-runtime storage redesign. At the measured 1024 Cache-DiT runtime, the entire text phase is under 2% of end-to-end wall time, so transformer attention remains higher leverage.
deferred.pack_prefetch: Do not implement independently while whole-shard text readahead competes for SSD bandwidth and page cache; the plan itself depends on landing the text ring first.
deferred.vae_overlap: Could hide part of VAE setup, but overlapping the 1.35 GB mapping and multi-GB 1024 scratch with the transformer needs an explicit 32 GB peak-memory gate.
deferred.mps_attention_output: Requires another full packed-weight policy/artifact change and was not justified before the dominant 1024 attention work.

end_to_end_smoke.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.
end_to_end_smoke.note: The total is dominated by a 19.679-second text paging outlier and is not used as the optimization comparison.
